articles.title: Watch live: Crew-12 launch and docking
articles.summary: Join ESA teams to watch live the launch and docking of Crew-12, marking the beginning of a nine‑month mission to the International Space Station.

articles.title: Crew-12 to Return ISS to Normal Complement
articles.summary: The crew of NASA’s Crew-12 mission arrived at Kennedy Space Center on February 6th, ahead of their planned launch to the International Space Station on Thursday, February 12th.

articles.title: Icy Hudson River
articles.summary: During a stretch of frigid weather in late January 2026, ice choked the Hudson River along Manhattan’s western shore. The OLI (Operational Land Imager) on Landsat 8 captured this image of the wintry landscape around midday on Jan. 28.
